name: Required Parameters
description: Required inputs and outputs for running CalculateContamination. Provide the tumor pileup summary table produced by GetPileupSummaries and specify the output contamination table filename.

name: Optional Parameters
description: Optional inputs and outputs for enhanced contamination estimation. Provide a matched normal pileup for more accurate results (matched normal mode), specify a tumor segmentation output file for aneuploid tumors, or supply an arguments file to pass additional GATK options.
